item.title: Seattle mass shooting leaves 3 dead; US and Iran pause hostilities
item.description: Three people died in a mass shooting at a Seattle festival. Meanwhile, the US and Iran have exchanged diplomatic messages after nearly two weeks.

item.title: Memphis anti-crime task force shifted focus to immigration enforcement
item.description: Federal agents in Memphis conducted widespread immigration arrests last fall, most involving individuals without criminal convictions, under President Trump.

item.title: France battles ongoing wildfires as Spain gains ground on blazes
item.description: A wildfire in southern France's Gironde region remains active, while two major fires in central Spain are being brought under control.

item.title: How Gen Z is challenging South Asia's elite
item.description: Young people in South Asia are turning the region's demographic dividend into a political challenge for leaders.
